# JSON for Modern C++

`json.hpp`, version 3.12.0, the release's single header: https://github.com/nlohmann/json
(release `v3.12.0`). MIT licence (`LICENSE.MIT`). SHA-256 of `json.hpp`: `aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`.

Used by `hiraku-server` only (its API, `server/`): no core and no desktop package has it.
